messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high error rate detected on model-serving-prod across model-id: redwood-open-7b-v2
sre-oncall: Seeing spike in truncation / tokenization errors, rolling error % from 0.03% -> 4.8% in last 5m
alice: Confirmed canary failed - tokenizer mismatch introduced by recent deploy. Logs show tokenizer_version=tokenizer-v3 while weights expect token-v2
ben: I'm on it, pulling the deploy artifact now. Possible tag mix: weights:v3 + tokenizer:v2 or vice versa
carla: Customer impact? any SLA/partner alerts triggered?
dylan: Support: 3 enterprise customers reported garbled outputs and tokenization artifacts in the last 10m. One reported hallucinated labels in autocomplete.
incident-bot: oncall: @sre-oncall, @alice, paging escalation level: P1. Runbook: model-rollout-failure -> assess impact, toggle fallback, rollback.
sre-oncall: Quick plan: 1) Enable fallback routing to safe-model redwood-open-7b-v1 2) Flip feature flag to disable new variant 3) Prepare rollback for artifact id=rel-2026-03-17-314
alice: Enabling fallback routing now: `route apply --from model.open.7b-v2 --to model.open.7b-v1 --temp 100%` -> started
alice: Feature flag flip: `flags set model-serving.v2.enabled false --env=prod` -> done :white_check_mark:
ben: Preparing rollback: `deploy rollback --artifact=rel-2026-03-17-314 --namespace=prod --reason='tokenizer mismatch'` Logs show weightset hash mismatch on 4 of 12 shards
sre-oncall: Traffic switching to fallback shows error rate down to 0.5% after 2m. customer error volume dropping.
carla: Notifying affected customers and CSMs. Drafting status update.
dylan: Logged customer tickets: #C-1982, #C-1983, #C-1984. Escalated to priority.
ben: Starting rollback now. ETA 6-8 minutes. Command output:
```
Rolling back artifact rel-2026-03-17-314
Stopping canary allocations...
Applying artifact rel-2026-03-17-309 (known-good)
Reassigning weightset -> succeeded on 8/12 shards
Pending: shard 9-12
```
sre-oncall: If rollback stalls, engage kill-switch: `kubectl annotate ns prod kill-switch=true` to prevent further canary promos
alice: Rollback completed on control plane. Verifying KV cache and tokenizer mapping... running smoke tests.
ben: Smoke tests: tokenization samples pass, perf within SLOs. Reopened customer sample flows - good on 2 test tenants.
sre-oncall: Monitoring for 30m. Error rate stable at baseline 0.04%. Marking incident as mitigated, but will keep channel open for postmortem.
carla: Customer comms sent. No data exfiltration. Root-cause: deploy pipeline allowed mismatched artifact tags to promote due to missing validation on tokenizer/weights compatibility metadata.
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated. Runbook next steps: postmortem, pipeline check, add pre-promote validator for tokenizer/weights hash match.
alice: Filing follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1420 (add pre-promote hash validation)
ben: Adding action: add canary guardrail to block mixed-version promotions. Will submit PR today.
carla: Thanks team. Closing paging for now. :bow:
